behavior: MarketScanner.last_scan_succeeded is false until the most recent attempt completed without endpoint/snapshot errors. Valid empty discovery is true; swallowed HTTP failure, timeout, bad endpoint schema, snapshot failure and partial endpoint failure remain false.

Scanner list API and qualified partial candidates remain compatible. Engine keeps individually qualified partial candidates and base/current universe, while degraded outcome increments failure count and does not update last success.

Completely failed/empty scans clear candidate pool. Successful empty discovery resets consecutive failures and updates last-success tick. Existing persistent-failure alert now describes retained qualified partial candidates accurately.

tests.suite_scope: scanner real-tick integration + market scanner contracts + W100 behavioral replay + exact baseline LOC + audit index/workflow tests

limitations: Tests use mocked provider HTTP and historical replay, not a live provider or deployed session.
Return-list compatibility preserves qualified partial discoveries; failed status does not by itself revoke previously admitted base/universe symbols.
Final combined organism safety/replay pack, regenerated candidate hashes/snapshots and hosted checks remain root-owned.
